publication_title: Exact reproduction and KS-atlas transfer of a Morales-Ramis obstruction near the parabolic Lagrange solution
claim_policy: Only claims marked authorized may appear as results. Context claims may appear only with their stated boundary. Prohibited claims must not appear as assertions.

claims.wording: The local planar complete-meromorphic-integrability obstruction near the parabolic Lagrange solution is published prior art due to Tsygvintsev and independently supported at theorem level by Boucher and Weil, on the Morales-Ramis foundation.
claims.boundary: No discovery, first-proof, or novelty claim is authorized before an independent literature review.

claims.wording: A source-disjoint exact implementation reconstructs the phase curve, full planar variational equation, Whittaker normal reduction, Fuchs gauge, and residue characteristic polynomials from the declared reduced Hamiltonian.
claims.boundary: The reconstruction starts from the published reduced Hamiltonian convention and does not independently derive every canonical reduction map from the unreduced state.

claims.wording: For every finite positive mass triple, the differential-Galois identity component of the reproduced four-dimensional normal variational equation is non-Abelian.
claims.boundary: This is a statement about the declared normal variational equation along one phase curve.

claims.wording: For every finite positive mass triple, the declared translation- and rotation-reduced planar Hamiltonian at fixed nonzero angular momentum is not completely integrable by meromorphic first integrals near the parabolic Lagrange phase curve.
claims.boundary: Local, complete, meromorphic, fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum statement only.

claims.wording: The reproduced planar normal variational module is a differential subquotient of the spatial variational module, so the local complete-meromorphic-integrability obstruction transfers to the translation-reduced spatial Hamiltonian.
claims.boundary: The argument uses the embedded planar phase curve at fixed nonzero angular momentum; it does not infer an ambient result merely from an invariant subsystem.

claims.wording: The qualified KS atlas admits no complete shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family on any domain containing the regular lift of the obstructed neighborhood.
claims.boundary: Requires shell regularity, Xi=0, gauge projectability, chart compatibility, and clock independence.

claims.wording: No promoted invariant survived WP3-MULTI-CAND-v2-KQ-v1 within its frozen 285-function library after quotienting the known L^2 class.
claims.boundary: Not a no-integral theorem, not a complete function search, and not a premise of C3 through C6.

claims.wording: WP1 validates the project orbit pipeline against a frozen external unequal-mass periodic-orbit dataset under its declared convention and tolerance contract.
claims.boundary: Numerical efficacy evidence only; not a premise of the nonintegrability theorem and not a completeness claim for all periodic orbits.

required_nonclaims.wording: The result does not exclude one additional integral.
The result does not exclude non-meromorphic integrability.
The result does not cover zero angular momentum.
The result does not classify all trajectories or all phase-space domains.
The result does not qualify nonzero-Xi dynamics or triple collision.

global nonintegrability of the three-body problem
